correctness.rationale: For p prime, p∤m, r>=1 and P=p^r, write k=bP+t. Independently derived v_p(C(mP,bP+t))=r-v_p(t)+h_b for 1<=t<P, and boundary value g_b. From v_p(N(n,k))=v_p(C(n,k))+v_p(C(n,k+1))-r, the interior equals r-v_p(t(t+1))+2h_b, while two boundary entries yield u^{g_b+h_b}+u^{g_{b+1}+h_b}. Exact p-adic shell counts are (p-2)p^{r-1} for valuation zero and 2(p-1)p^{r-d-1} for valuation d (1<=d<r); hence the stated histogram and rational bivariate GF by geometric series. Coupling T mod p^r to Haar-uniform Z∈Z_p excludes exactly T=0,p^r-1, total probability 2p^-r, giving the shifted geometric law with the same total-variation bound. Independently enumerated 92 exact Narayana rows for several p,m,r and checked the formal rational GF. Infinite assertions rely on digit/coupling proof, not enumeration.
